source.implements: Overview (before the battle): Warlord, enhancements, attached units, detachments (each opens its detachment rule), the army rules (folded), units with Deep Strike (24.09: every model must have it), transports, Scouts and Infiltrators (24.31, 24.20: every model must have it), start of the battle / round 1 / every round, once-per-battle items; the army rules block also holds the detachment rules (as on the Rules tab); an enhancement's holder by its full name when another unit of the list has the same short name

Phase checklist: the army and detachment rules, options and abilities of the list ckListed / ckOptListed lists (unless a unit of the list has the option as an ability: listed as theirs; the same ability on several units one line, a copy the list cannot use apart, marked); a rule or ability listed only through options with moments of their own is listed once, as itself, without them, at each end moment they name (Code Chivalric: End of your turn, of your opponent's, of the battle round); by data.js CHECKLIST (verify/derive.js): To do now in each phase and turn its text says it is triggered (07.02: the phases; either turn: both), or under the moment it opens with (Start of the (first) battle round) or a sentence at the end of the battle round (ae), sections in the order of the game (End of your turn, End of your opponent's turn, then End of the battle round, after Fight · Their turn); Active now where its effect is used and it is not triggered; once-per-battle uses (perBattle; Kindred Sorcery's options each) under Once per battle, from where they are triggered (an option from where its rule is), with the Overview's boxes, and nothing of what they put in force; for the others, what they put in force from a rule of the list (f: "Riled up (X) · Waaagh!") and the ability they select (pickOptions: Active now where it is used, its own use or, made only of options, theirs when every one is read, within pk; not read: pk's whole duration; pk not read: When unclear; an ability a listed one selects names its selector on every line of it, "The Blood God's Favour (Wrathful Presence)"; not one listed itself, rolled, or whose own trigger is a unit activation, a); each line names its unit or source and opens the full text; a rule another rule of the list gives to units by keyword (g) says which and to whom; the battle rounds a rule's words name, quoted on its line ("(first, third and fifth battle rounds)", Harbingers of Dread); entries made of a named roll placed where the list makes it (ckRolled); inert rules and abilities the list cannot use are listed, marked; listed ones the table cannot place under When unclear, those with no phase under No phase; no stratagems; each section a fold (closed until opened, kept for the session), its line counting each part; a box per line per section, kept per list; Reset clears them (with Undo), not the once-per-battle ones
